title: humancompatible.detect: a Python Toolkit for Detecting Bias in AI Models

bias_targets.methodology: Applying Maximum Subgroup Discrepancy (MSD) on a synthetic dataset to calculate the gap in positive outcomes between different racial groups and the overall population, specifically highlighting how marginal fairness can mask intersectional racial bias.
Using Maximum Subgroup Discrepancy (MSD) to evaluate differences in positive outcome probabilities across various age buckets (e.g., 0-18, 18-30) to identify disadvantaged intersectional subgroups.

Utilizing subsampled ℓ∞ distances to test whether the distribution of positive outcomes for a specific gender (e.g., female) differs from the full population by more than a predefined tolerance threshold.
